sources.title: Alphan Özcan — AI/ML Developer & Entrepreneur
sources.snippet: Cofounded and engineered the backend for CrasAI (crasai.com), a multi-model AI platform unifying text, image generation, and data processing in one interface. Designed a Go-based backend with an original automatic model-selection algorithm that routes each request to the fastest, most suitable model.

sources.title: GitHub - ml-explore/mlx-lm: Run LLMs with MLX
sources.snippet: MLX LM is a Python package for generating text and fine-tuning large language models on Apple silicon with MLX. Some key features include: Integration with the Hugging Face Hub to easily use thousands of LLMs with a single command. Support for quantizing and uploading models to the Hugging Face Hub. Low-rank and full model fine-tuning with support for quantized models. Distributed inference ...
